doc.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21

title: Bix as pianist
summary: Mugsy says Bix was influenced by piano and would perhaps have turned to the classics.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: He was quite a pure player then. He was? He was really influenced by the piano. Yes. Oh, that shows on his records. On his piano things. Did he write most of his tunes on the piano? Oh, yes. Those are all original. To me, on the piano. No one knows what he really amounted to for your life today. Yeah. No one knows. It might have been greater than him. They'd write about you with body pooped out. I think he'd probably have gone to the piano. You think so? I think so. He would have left his chorus completely. Well, he'd probably go to the classics and all. Thanks. Mm-hm.
